name: Three Eyed Familiar
description: A tiny chittering thing with three unblinking eyes. Whispers arcane secrets to its bearer (+1 INT) and slowly knits their wounds (regen 1 HP every 5s).

name: Testament of Faith
description: A small leather-bound book of devotions, worn smooth by countless hands. A soft holy radiance pours from its pages.

name: Talisman of the Wind
description: A feather-light charm that guides your aim (+2 DEX, +5 Bow Damage).

name: Bulwark of the Ancestors
description: A heavy iron crest bearing an ancient dwarven clan mark (+2 VIT, +1 RES, +10% Shield Block Chance).

name: Bloodstone Amulet
description: A dark, jagged crystal that hums with savage fury (+3 STR, +5% Critical Hit Chance).

name: Tracker's Medallion
description: A polished brass medallion inscribed with runes of protection (+1 DEX, +1 INT, +15% Resistance to all elements).

name: Crescent Moon Charm
description: A delicate silver charm that catches the light (+3 DEX, +10% Dodge Chance).

name: Heartwood Charm
description: A knot of ancient living heartwood, still faintly green at its core. It slowly knits the bearer's wounds and steadies both body and mind (+1 VIT, +1 INT, regen 2 HP every 5s).

name: Eye of Malice
description: A demon's eye sealed in dark crystal, forever open and forever hateful. It lends its bearer infernal insight and a cruel edge to their spellcraft (+2 INT, +10% elemental spell damage, fire & dark resistance).

name: Stormcore Relic
description: The humming magnetic core of an iron warden, bound in copper wire. It crackles with caged lightning, channelling that current into the bearer's strikes (+5 lightning damage to every attack) while grounding harmful currents away (lightning resistance, regen 1 HP every 5s).
